about: INVENTORY (2026-10-06) of what the Peregrine needs to stop borrowing (AcAudioDirector, AcNewKinds, AcConsoleInfo): weapon seekers (own, in the game); driven pull-away peregrinepass (own, in the game: the shriek is also its in-ear engine, so no separate peregrinemove is made); report-in vperegrine and death peregrinedeath (BLOCKED, see below); HUD icon peregrine (made 2026-10-06: Content-src/icons/peregrine.png from the peregrine_blue model, art/models/peregrine/previews/icon.png); no lock-on, bury or footfall sound applies. VOICE (2026-10-09): the ElevenLabs account has no free custom voice slot (10 of 10, all game voices), so the pilot speaks with a library voice, which needs no slot: "The Fox - Strict & Dominating" (h1IssowVS2h4nL5ZbkkK, a precise, controlled commander baritone), picked by ear by the user from four library candidates through comm.py. The brief: a cool, precise, terse interceptor ace in his thirties, flat and controlled, lower and slower than the Kestrel's cocky jock. The Voice Design previews made on 2026-10-06 stay in art/models/peregrine/sounds/voice/ (unsaved, expired).

entries.prompt: alien fighter craft screams past overhead: an eerie, rising, almost organic shriek like a hunting bird mixed with a whining engine, sharp doppler pass, fading quickly, sci-fi
small sleek alien interceptor dives past: a piercing, wavering, otherworldly scream that rises in pitch then drops with doppler, hollow resonant whistle, unsettling, sci-fi
fast sci-fi fighter makes a strafing pass: an eerie high-pitched howling whine with a living, animal shriek in it, sweeping left to right with doppler shift, menacing
swarm fighter flies by fast and low: a chilling, warbling, banshee-like electronic shriek rising to a peak and falling away, airy hiss of thrust underneath, sci-fi
two small air-to-air seeker missiles launch in quick succession from under a fighter's wings: sharp fssh-fssh of tiny rocket motors streaking away, thin whistle, close up
pair of homing missiles fired from a jet fighter: quick crisp hiss-hiss launch and a rising whistle as they zip off, light and fast, close up

entries.text: [cool, terse] Peregrine on station. Seekers armed.
[flat, focused] Give me a target in the sky.
[quiet, controlled] Escort is up. Nothing touches you.
